field.label: Enable Xray Client
field.help: Enable or disable the Xray client service.

field.label: Configuration Mode
field.help: Select whether to generate config.json from UI tabs (Nodes + Routing Rules) or use a raw JSON config.

field.label: Expert Mode
field.help: Show an extra "Expert Config" tab with the exact /usr/local/etc/xray/config.json Xray is running (or would run). You can view it or edit it manually; saving there switches the plugin to Raw JSON mode, and the config is validated with xray run -test before it is applied.

field.label: Log Level
field.help: Logging verbosity for Xray-core.

field.label: Enable Access Log
field.help: Write every proxied connection to /var/log/xray/access.log. Off by default: with the TUN inbound all network traffic is logged and the file grows without rotation. Enable only while debugging, and clear it in the Logs tab afterwards.

field.label: Enable Native TUN Inbound
field.help: Xray creates the interface itself while the service runs (it does not exist otherwise). Enable this, Apply, then assign it under Interfaces -> Assignments.

field.label: TUN Interface Name
field.help: System interface name Xray creates for the TUN inbound (default: tun_xray0). Visible in Interfaces -> Assignments while Xray is running.

field.label: TUN Tunnel Subnet
field.help: Gateway prefix for the TUN inbound (default: 10.255.0.1/30, CIDR 1..31). Xray keeps the gateway address for itself as the in-tunnel endpoint and assigns the next address to the interface (10.255.0.2 for a /30). Route traffic to the gateway via an assigned gateway + policy rule.

field.label: TUN MTU
field.help: Maximum Transmission Unit for the TUN interface (default: 1500).

field.label: Enable Domain Sniffing (TLS/HTTP/QUIC)
field.help: Required for domain-based routing rules (geosite:ru, etc.) when traffic comes via IP through the TUN interface.

field.label: Enable Local SOCKS5 Proxy
field.help: Enable local SOCKS5 inbound (with UDP support) for apps and healthchecks.

field.label: Listen IP Address
field.help: IP to bind local SOCKS/HTTP ports (use 127.0.0.1 for local only, or 0.0.0.0 / LAN IP for LAN devices). These proxies have no authentication: if you bind to anything other than 127.0.0.1, restrict access with firewall rules so that only trusted hosts can reach the ports.

field.label: SOCKS5 Port
field.help: Port for SOCKS5 inbound (default: 10808).

field.label: Enable Local HTTP Proxy
field.help: Enable local HTTP proxy inbound.

field.label: HTTP Port
field.help: Port for HTTP proxy inbound (default: 10809).

field.label: Internal gRPC Stats API Port
field.help: Local loopback port used by the plugin to query live traffic counters from Xray (default: 10085).

field.label: Domain Strategy
field.help: How Xray matches domain rules that fell through to IP matching: IPIfNonMatch (default) — resolve and retry; IPOnDemand — resolve only when an IP rule actually needs it; AsIs — never resolve (cheapest, leaks nothing to DNS, but geoip/country rules never match a bare domain).

field.label: Enable Automatic Latency & Traffic Polling
field.help: When enabled, the Outbound Nodes table refreshes traffic automatically at the interval below, and latency every 5 minutes on a separate timer, without clicking the button.

field.label: Traffic Polling Interval (seconds)
field.help: How often to fetch traffic counters in the background (30-3600 seconds, default 60). Latency is polled every 5 minutes independently.

field.label: Observatory Type
field.help: leastPing and leastLoad balancers need Xray to probe the nodes. «Burst observatory» probes in batches and is the recommended option; «Background observatory» probes continuously. «Disabled» keeps the raw observatory JSON from Advanced JSON Sections (if set). Turning this on takes precedence over that raw field.

field.label: Probe Targets (tag prefixes)
field.help: Comma-separated outbound tag prefixes to probe (default: node_, i.e. every configured node). Prefixes are matched from the start of the outbound tag.

field.label: Probe URL
field.help: HTTP(S) URL used to measure each node (default: https://connectivitycheck.gstatic.com/generate_204). Use a small, stable page on the far side of the tunnel.

field.label: Probe Interval
field.help: Time between probe rounds, as a Go duration: 10s, 1m, 1h (default: 1m). With burst observatory this is pingConfig.interval; with the background observatory it is probeInterval.

field.label: Samples per Probe Round (burst only)
field.help: How many probes to send per node in each burst (default: 10). Lower values react faster, higher values smooth out jitter. Ignored by the background observatory.

field.label: Probe Timeout (burst only)
field.help: Timeout of a single probe, e.g. 5s (default: 5s). Ignored by the background observatory.

field.label: HTTP Method (burst only)
field.help: GET, HEAD or empty for Xray's default (HEAD). HEAD is lighter; GET works with servers that reject HEAD. Ignored by the background observatory.

field.label: Probe Nodes Concurrently (background only)
field.help: Probe all selected nodes at the same time instead of one after another. Useful with many nodes. Ignored by the burst observatory.

field.label: Enable Built-in DNS
field.help: Route domain resolution through Xray's own DNS server instead of the system resolver. Addresses are looked up from the DNS Servers tab (or, when disabled, from the raw dns JSON in Advanced JSON Sections). Domains still unmatched by any routing rule go direct.

field.label: Query Strategy
field.help: Which addresses servers are allowed to answer with: IPv4 and IPv6 (default), IPv4 only or IPv6 only.

field.label: Disable DNS Cache
field.help: Do not cache DNS answers. Useful for testing domains whose DNS changes often; costs a query per lookup in production.

field.label: Disable Fallback
field.help: If every domain-matched server fails, do not ask the untagged servers instead (strict DNS).

field.label: Disable Fallback If Match
field.help: Once a request matched a domain-tagged server, fail instead of falling back to untagged servers when it cannot answer.

field.label: Parallel Query
field.help: Query all matching servers at once and use the first answer. Higher traffic, faster answers, but can downgrade a domestic resolver's accuracy.

field.label: Use System Hosts
field.help: Feed /etc/hosts into the built-in DNS as static hosts.
